title: Nested (our Project Nested fork): Nested VRUN built with the core assembled from source
description: The workspace entry of our own Project Nested fork: branch nested-vrun-core of Nested_VRUN/Project-Nested-core (v1.8 + the 18 Nested VRUN core steps as Assembly/ source, assembled by tools/nestedasm). Builds the same game as vrun-nested, but the core is assembled from source by 'brokendev.ps1 nested build' instead of master's binary patch chain (core/build_core.py). Since 2026-11-10 the fork also carries the NES to SNES pipeline (tools/m30pipe, from master) and the injector's source on .NET 10 (Project Nested/, net10.0-windows): 'nested' builds the injector with dotnet build and runs the pipeline on pwsh 7.6+. Golden hashes: golden.json, 'brokendev.ps1 nested test'.

source.git: Project-Nested-core is a worktree of Project-Nested (branch nested-vrun-core, remote brokendev = T:/BrokenDev/Projects/Nested_VRUN.git)

toolchain: Project Nested injector built from the fork's source: .NET 10 SDK (dotnet build -c Release, net10.0-windows)

steps.name: nested-from-source
steps.note: The core is assembled from source (profile vrun, md5 57c4a845...), then the same recipe as vrun-nested.

knownIssues: The same game issues as vrun-nested (no NES lag-frame model; feedback only covers the scripted plans).

Core, injector (.NET 10) and pipeline all come from the fork; master's prebuilt .NET Framework exe is no longer used by 'nested'. -Feedback harvest (Mesen bootstrap) still uses master's binary-chain core, so 'nested build' does not offer it.
Project-Nested-core lives only in the live VRUN_Nes_Dev workspace (not in the restored archive): from a worktree outside PROJECTS set BROKENDEV_LIVE_VRUN_NES_DEV.
